contexts.text: The bases of brass = natural goods.
The earth = the Church; the bases upon which it is founded () = truths in ultimates, like those of the Word in its literal sense; hence it is said, that it shall not be removed to eternity.

Forty bases of silver = plenary support by means of the Word... Bases = support, for bases do support... The reason the bases were of silver, and the boards covered over with gold, was that by the boards is signified good, and by the bases, truth; and good has power and support by means of truth.
The bases also correspond to the feet and soles of the feet in man; and in general, to the bones, which support all the fleshy part of the body...
The bases () = the truths themselves which support.
That the truth which is signified by the bases, is that which proceeds from that good, is signified by the bases being under the boards.
Two bases under one board = the conjunction of it with good... The bases = the truth by means of which there is support. AC 9661.
Two bases under one board for its two hands = thus in each and all things.
There shall be eight boards and their bases of silver = support in every possible way by good, and through truth from good... Bases of silver = support by means of the truth which is from good.
Sixteen bases = complete support... Bases = support.
Upon the four bases of silver = the power of conjunction by means of truth... Bases = power.
Thou shalt cast for them five bases of brass = the power from outward good. Bases = the power which gives support.
Their twenty bases of brass = truths from good also giving full support... Bases = truths of faith from good. AC 9753.
Their pillars and the ten bases of these = goods and thence truths also giving support sufficient for uses... Bases = truths from good also giving support.
Their bases of brass = supports by means of good. Bases = supports.
Thus does (the Word) serve as a basis and foundation for the Heavens.
By a base is signified that which is ultimate, and gives support.

The base (of the laver) of brass = the good of the ultimate Natural, which is the Sensual... The reason the base = the ultimate of the Natural, which is called the outward Sensual, is that by the laver which is above it, is signified the Natural in which purification takes place; hence by that which is below, is signified that which is in the lowest place, that is, in the ultimate, thus the outward Sensual of man. Explained.

The good of the Sensual, which is signified by the base of brass, is what is called the pleasure and delight which affect the imaginative thought, which thought is merely from earthly, bodily, and worldly things, and is distinguished from other delights by its not having regard to any uses but those which are for self.
The laver and its base = all things which belong to purification from evils and falsities, and to regeneration by the Lord... Its base = the Sensual supporting and ministering. AC 10345.
The Corporeal of man... upon which, as upon its basis, (Heaven) stands firm.
Man, who is the basis of the Heavens...
Hence it is evident, that the ultimate of Divine order is in man, and as he is the ultimate, he is the basis and foundation.

But as man broke this connexion with Heaven... and no longer served Heaven as a basis and foundation, a medium has been provided by the Lord, which should be in the place of a basis and foundation for Heaven, and also for the conjunction of Heaven with man. This medium is the Word.
The sense of its letter serves as a basis and foundation.
That the human race is the basis upon which Heaven is founded, is because man was last created, and that which is the last created is the basis of all the things which go before. Explained.
When a man dies, then, being a Spirit, he does not subsist upon his Own basis, but upon the general basis, which is the human race.
The human race on this Earth would have perished... unless the Lord had here given a Word of such a character, that it would be as a basis for the angelic Heaven, and a means of conjunction with it.

These things are set forth in the sense of the letter by means of natural things, because natural things serve spiritual ones as a basis, and without such a basis the Word would not be a Divine Work, because not complete...
The sense of the letter of the Word is the basis, containant, and support of its spiritual and celestial sense. General article. TCR 210.
Hence the ultimate is the basis... As the ultimate is the containant and the basis, it is also the support.
The human race is the basis, containant, and support of (the Heavens), and with men, and in them, is the Word.
The ultimate degree is the complex, the containant, and the basis, of the prior degrees. General article. DLW 216.
That an effect is the complex, the containant, and the basis of its causes and ends... As the ultimate is the complex, it follows that the ultimate is the containant, and also the basis.
Use is the complex, the containant, and the basis of wisdom and love.
The sense of the letter is not only the complex, the containant, and the basis of the corresponding interior senses...
Jehovah hath founded the earth upon its bases, that it should not be removed to eternity... The bases upon which Jehovah hath founded it to eternity, are the Knowledges of truth and of good.
The bases, etc. () = the foundation of the Church with man upon those things which are in the natural man.
The bases of the earth () = exterior truths, such as those of the sense of the letter of the Word, for interior truths are founded upon these.
